reason: I make under $5k a month and mostly get clients from posting, so $147 on a tool with zero results published is a hard sell. Seven seats taken and no case studies tells me nobody has proven it books a single call.
objection: There are no reviews or case studies, so how do I know it books calls? I'd be putting my own Instagram on the line and paying $147 a month to find out, and after day 3 payments are final.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from a few agency owners or freelancers like me, with actual numbers for replies and booked calls. A free trial with no card up front would also get me to try it.
